scenarios.name: admission
scenarios.description: Send valid transactions from many accounts and measure how fast the pool admits them.

scenarios.name: admission-rejections
scenarios.description: Send invalid transaction variants and record how the client rejects each one.

scenarios.name: nonce-gap-promotion
scenarios.description: Send transactions with a nonce gap, then fill the gap and measure the promotion time.

scenarios.name: replacement
scenarios.description: Replace pending transactions with a higher fee and check the price bump rule.

scenarios.name: payload-ordering

scenarios.name: reorg-reinjection
